entry.title: Lighthouse of Genoa
entry.note: Main square shaft centered on exact mapped core with parallel axes. Crest is authored on -Z, giving the north-facing facade identified explicitly by operator PHAROS Heritage; the rounded access buttress lies at the northwest base. Height is from local rock contact, not sea level. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
